title: Stalled promotion: container image tag namespace mismatch caused partial canary serve and rollback failure
creator: Asha Patel
description: During a routine canary->promote rollout for model-x (v2026-02-26), a subset of replicas in two availability zones resolved a container image tag to an older digest due to a namespacing mismatch between our internal artifact registry and the cloud registry mirror. The mixed digests caused the new model to be partially served while the orchestrator completed a rollout state transition. An automated rollback was triggered but the rollback by tag resolution returned the same ambiguous tag (different digests in different zones), so the rollback was effectively a no-op. Simultaneously, KV cache key namespaces were inconsistent between the two model binaries and the KV warmup/invalidation didn't reconcile, producing stale responses for a portion of traffic for ~27 minutes before the on-call manual mitigation forced a digest-pinned re-deploy. This ticket captures the incident analysis, remediation, and follow-ups.

impact_summary: Approximately 27 minutes of partial degraded service for a subset of customers routed to the affected AZs. Errors surfaced as higher 5xx rates and notable semantic output divergence on model generation for 2.1% of total requests during the window. No customer data was exposed; impact limited to availability and model correctness.
root_cause: We relied on mutable image tags for rollouts and assumed tag resolution was globally consistent. A namespacing misconfiguration caused the cloud registry mirror to return an older image digest for the same tag in some zones. The rollout engine and the rollback logic operate at tag level (not digest), so both promotion and rollback could resolve to inconsistent digests. Additionally, KV cache keys were not strongly versioned by image digest, allowing stale KV entries to survive across mixed-binary deployments.
remediation: Enforce digest-pinned deploys: orchestrator will require sha256 digest for any production rollout; tags are accepted only for preproduction manifests
Add a rollout gate: pre-deploy artifact-digest verification across all mirrors/regions. Block promotion if any registry mirror returns a different digest for the same tag
Rollback by digest: enhance rollback to use the previous known good digest instead of re-resolving the tag
KV cache versioning: include model image digest and schema version in KV cache namespace keys and invalidation protocol
Add a canary health probe that asserts model artifact hash, KV version parity, and sample-output similarity before traffic increase
Improve incident playbook: explicit steps to detect tag/digest divergence and force digest-pinned recovery
Create a periodic audit job to validate registry mirror consistency for tags used in prod
